run_parse_sphinx_cli: run the parse_sphinx script with -i input_dir -o output_dir to strip HTML body from Sphinx docs
run_parse_sphinx_search: run parse_sphinx on a Sphinx HTML directory that includes search.html to add search JS scripts
run_parse_sphinx_docusaurus: run parse_sphinx to convert Sphinx HTML docs for use in a Docusaurus output directory
review_parse_sphinx_function: review the parse_sphinx function that walks an input directory and wraps document divs with sphinx class
refactor_parse_sphinx_js: refactor parse_sphinx to update the searchtools.js file path reference from URL_ROOT to _sphinx-sources
